string.body: I will not let you live!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF1A_GargoyleD_19_Batk_S
string.body: I will not let you live!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1A_B_BrownieMWo_13_An_Flee
string.body: Kobold doesn't want to die. Kobold run away!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1_Lehpar_AnD_001_Katk1_S
string.body: Exhausted already? I will finish you now!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF1_Lehpar_FnQ_001_Katk1_B
string.body: Not bad. Shame you are about to die.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lycan_FNA_1_KATK1_b
string.body: We will not stand forrr thiss!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lycan_FEA_1_KATK3_b
string.body: Poison, be gone frrrom my blllood!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lycan_KNC_1_KATK2_b
string.body: You'll have to do betterrr than that!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lycan_HEA_1_KATK3_b
string.body: Runnn, if you wish to live!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lycan_WEA_1_KATK3_b
string.body: That trrrick will not work twice!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lycan_WEB_1_KATK3_b
string.body: That trrrick will not work twice!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Brownie_FNQ_3_acc
string.body: Turn you into Krall chow, I will!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lycan_KeA_3_statup
string.body: Your worrrthless gods will not save you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lycan_FEB_6_attack
string.body: Next time, brrring your grrreatest warrior!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Brownie_FNR_3_acc
string.body: It's a whole pack of them!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_FNB_1_KATK1_b
string.body: I'm not just going to take it like this.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_FEA_1_KATK1_b
string.body: I'm not just going to take it like this.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_FEA_1_KATK7_b
string.body: Do not anger me any further!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_KNB_1_KATK2_b
string.body: Do it properly, if you are going to attack!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_KNC_1_KATK2_b
string.body: Do you think I will lose to you?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_KNC_2_KATK2_b
string.body: The same trick won't work twice!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_KEA_1_KATK2_b
string.body: This is nothing! Give it your best shot!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_KEA_1_KATK6_b
string.body: That kind of attacks will not work anymore.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_KEB_1_KATK6_b
string.body: You better run while you can!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_KEA_3_attack
string.body: Let us have a good fight!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_REB_1_KATK5_b
string.body: You all better run away now!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Krall_WEA_1_KATK3_b
string.body: I refuse to take it anymore!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Brownie_FNQ_3_attack
string.body: Turn you into Krall chow, I will!

string.name: STR_CHAT_NLehpar_K_1_attack
string.body: Do you think you can bind me with that?

string.name: STR_CHAT_NLehpar_KEA_4_attack
string.body: Do you think that'll defeat me?

string.name: STR_CHAT_NLehpar_W_1_attack
string.body: You dared to put me to sleep... Don't expect any mercy!

string.name: STR_CHAT_NLehpar_W_2_direction
string.body: Time for you to get some rest!

string.name: STR_CHAT_NLehpar_WNA_5_attack
string.body: You are only good enough to face a pretor!

string.name: STR_CHAT_NLehpar_WEA_5_attack
string.body: Prepare yourself to be turned into a pretor!

string.name: STR_CHAT_NLehpar_P_8_attack
string.body: You will be running after this blow!

string.name: STR_CHAT_NLehpar_PNA_2_attack
string.body: Don't think this is the end!

string.name: STR_CHAT_NKrall_FEB_3_help
string.body: I need help! Help me, everyone!

string.name: STR_CHAT_NKrall_WEB_2_attack
string.body: I won't even let you utter a spell!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_FnA_1_katk3_b
string.body: I could beat you even without my armour.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_FnB_1_katk2_b
string.body: Huhuhu, calm down a bit there.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_FnB_1_katk3_b
string.body: Do what you will, but you'll return to the flow of Aether.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_FnB_1_katk4_b
string.body: Do you think I'll go down like this!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_FeA_1_katk2_b
string.body: I will have you paralysed in fear!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_FeA_1_katk3_b
string.body: Only thing that awaits you is death.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_FeA_1_katk4_b
string.body: Did you think you could get me with such a feeble attack?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_FeA_1_katk5_b
string.body: You won't be able to dodge this!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_FeA_1_katk6_b
string.body: I will finish you with this hand!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_AnA_1_katk3_b
string.body: Must you see blood before you come to your senses?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_AnA_C2_1_katk5_b
string.body: Be ware of what's behind your back!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_AnC_1_katk3_b
string.body: Must you see blood before you come to your senses?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_AnC_1_katk4_b
string.body: Hahaha, I will cover your whole body with wounds.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_AnC_1_katk6_b
string.body: That kind of attacks only tickles me.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Nlehpar_AeA_1_katk3_b

string.body: It is time I showed you my power.

string.body: Something this coming out from my body, kuwaak.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BDF3_NM_DrakanDF3Boss_48_Ah_1_Katk6_b
string.body: Burn in a blaze of fire!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BDF3_NM_LehparZombie_45_Ah_1_Katk5_b
string.body: I will not let you get away with this.

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_65
string.body: Looks like we need more children here.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF2A_NM_DMGhostPriest_25_An_1_Katk1_b
string.body: I need to finish the excavation too...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF2A_NM_DMGhostPriest_25_An_1_Katk3_b
string.body: I cannot return to the flow of Aether like this!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF2A_NM_DarkManAs_23_An_1_Katk1_b
string.body: You aren't good enough to face me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF2A_NM_DarkManAs_23_An_1_Katk4_b
string.body: Do you think you can ever catch me?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF2A_NM_DarkManAs_23_An_1_Kcast5_b
string.body: Why don't you just give up?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF2A_NM_Harpy_24_Ae_1_Katk2_b
string.body: It is all your... fault... Kieeek!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF2A_NM_Harpy_24_Ae_1_Katk4_b
string.body: Kyaah! To what it was before...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF2A_NM_DarkManWi_24_An_1_Katk1_b
string.body: What do you want with me?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF2A_NM_DarkManWi_24_An_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: To anyone who messes with me

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF2A_NM_DarkManWi_24_An_1_Katk3_b
string.body: Hoho, I see that you also want to taste the special stew.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BDF2A_NM_LightPriest_25_1_Katk1_b
string.body: All sorts of ruffians come here now.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BDF2A_NM_LightPriest_25_1_Katk2_b
string.body: What an ungainly, pitiful appearance, tsk tsk.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BDF2A_NM_Lich_24_1_Katk4_b
string.body: You lot really are vulnerable to fear, kukuku.

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_70
string.body: A more powerful foe would be better!

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_74
string.body: Let's show our power to these fools!

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_76
string.body: Teach these wretches a lesson, children.

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_77
string.body: Balaur, teach these runts a good lesson!

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_78
string.body: Do not think this is the end!

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_79
string.body: Stop! Do you know where this is?

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_81
string.body: Minion of darkness, thou shalt rise from thy deep slumber!

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_82
string.body: Servant of darkness, it is time for thy revenge!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DeathKnightSum_43_An_1_Kcast1_b
string.body: By the will of my master

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LehparFi_42_Ah_1_Katk2_b
string.body: I won't go down like this!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DrakanDF3Boss_48_Ah_1_Katk1_b
string.body: Thy courage is commendable, to have come this far.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DrakanDF3Boss_48_Ah_1_Katk6_b
string.body: Burn in a blaze of fire!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DrakanDF3Boss_48_Ah_1_Kcast7_b
string.body: 'Tis an honour to fall by mine hands.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DrakanDF3Slave2_48_Ae_1_Katk1_b
string.body: Krr, it's been a while since I last feasted.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_Cherubim2_46_Ah_1_Katk2_b
string.body: Return to where you come from, keru!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_Cherubim4_48_Al_1_Kcast1_b
string.body: Zapiel is hungry, me eat Daeva!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_CrazyKrallFi_42_Ah_1_Kcast7_b
string.body: This is the power of Aether!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostFi_49_Ah_1_Katk2_b
string.body: You should be at least this good if you want to do it, huhuhu.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostFi_49_Ah_1_Katk3_b
string.body: Stay still and wait for your death!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostFi_49_Ah_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: It is now time to part.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_NagaFighter_47_Ah_1_Katk3_b
string.body: I will show you the might of Indratu Legion, sheek.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_NagaFighter_47_Ah_1_Katk4_b
string.body: I will divest all of your lives.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LizardFighter_44_Ah_1_Katk5_b
string.body: I'll show you the power of Balaur!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LizardFighter_44_Ah_1_Katk7_b
string.body: You are a perfect sacrifice for his Majesty, the Dragon Lord!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LizardmanPR_44_Ah_1_Katk1_b
string.body: You would be a perfect cadaver.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LizardmanPR_44_Ah_1_Katk8_b
string.body: You are one tenacious little bugger!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_NagaPriest_47_Ah_1_Katk6_b
string.body: I will let you live, if you kneel and beg, sheek!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostPr_49_Ah_1_Katk1_b
string.body: Do you want know the true darkness?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostPr_49_Ah_1_Katk4_b
string.body: You cannot defeat me with your feeble strength.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostPr_49_Ah_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: I want to see you trembling with fear!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LehparChanter_42_Ah_1_Katk2_b
string.body: Haap, have a taste of this club!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LehparChanter_42_Ah_1_Katk3_b
string.body: It's no use even if you beg for forgiveness!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LehparChanter_42_Ah_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: You dare to soil this holy kitchen with your dirty feet!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LehparChanter_42_Ah_1_Katk4_b
string.body: You are like a pack of Bellepig!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LehparChanter_42_Ah_1_Katk6_b
string.body: Your whole body will feel as heavy as lead!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_Agrint_43_Ah_1_Katk3_b
string.body: I shall use you as nutrients.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_Agrint_43_Ah_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: Feel it, the wrath of agrint...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_Agrint_43_Ah_1_Katk5_b
string.body: Strong, is the power of nature...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_Agrint_43_Ah_1_Katk6_b
string.body: For you, there shall be no mercy...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_CrazyKrallRA_41_Ah_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: I have no time to deal with the likes of you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_CrazyKrallRA_41_Ah_1_Katk7_b
string.body: Show the power of Aether to them!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LizardmanRA_46_Ah_1_Katk2_b
string.body: I'll teach you a hot lesson!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LizardmanAS_42_Ah_1_Katk1_b
string.body: A toy has walked in by itself, kwak.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LizardmanAS_42_Ah_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: Is that all for your attacks?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_BoneDrake_45_Al_1_Kcast7_b
string.body: Live sacrifices have just walked in...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_BoneDrake_45_Al_1_Katk7_b
string.body: I will gladly accept those lives...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_PerfectMan_45_Ah_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: Great timing, I was just looking for someone to train against.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_PerfectMan_45_Ah_1_Kcast5_b
string.body: Attacks from an incomplete Daeva are just...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_PerfectMan_45_Ah_1_Katk5_b
string.body: Groan, I will not let you get away with this.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_Key_LehparWiW_42_ah_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: See the might of the Lepharists!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LehparWiW_42_Ah_1_Katk2_b
string.body: Please be quiet in the library.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_LehparWiW_42_Ah_1_Kcast3_b
string.body: I see that words aren't enough.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_NagaWizard_47_Ah_1_Katk3_b
string.body: Witness the power of Balaur. Sheek!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_NagaWizard_47_Ah_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: I need more magical power, sheek.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_NagaWizard_47_Ah_1_Katk9_b
string.body: I will turn you to ashes in an instant!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_NagaWizard_47_Ah_1_Katk10_b
string.body: You cannot leave my grasp, sheek!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_NagaElemental_48_Ah_1_Katk6_b
string.body: I need more magical power, sheek.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_NagaElemental_48_Ah_1_Katk7_b
string.body: Give your life to me, sheek.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_NagaElemental_48_Ah_1_Katk10_b
string.body: This will be your grave, sheek!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostEL_42_Ae_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: What business does a living have at a graveyard!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostEL_42_Ae_1_Katk2_b
string.body: Curses to those who disturb my rest!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostEL_42_Ae_1_Katk3_b
string.body: Your soul, it's full of life...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_VampireSumVam_52_Ae_1_Katk1_b
string.body: Kwak, there is not enough blood...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostWi_49_Ah_1_Kcast5_b
string.body: Attacks from the weak are of no use!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_DMGhostWi_49_Ah_1_Katk5_b
string.body: You are destined to end your life here!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLF3_NM_Lich_45_Ah_1_Kcast5_b
string.body: Witness the power bestowed by Lord Bollvig!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BD3_Lizardman_AeD_45_An_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: I will take care of you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BD3_Lizardman_AeD_45_An_1_Kcast7_b
string.body: The days of Daevas are finished!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Lizardman_PeD_1_Kcast1_b
string.body: Are you the sacrifices for the god?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DrGuard_FhA_H1_Despawn
string.body: The Castle Gate is destroyed! Fall back!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DrGuard_FhA_H2_Despawn
string.body: The Aetheric Barrier has disappeared! Fall back!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DrGuard_FhA_H3_Despawn
string.body: The enemy teleporter is dead! Fall back!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Field_NPC_HelpCall_Male_2_Batk_B
string.body: Guard! The enemies are attacking here!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Field_NPC_HelpCall_Female_2_Batk_B
string.body: Is anyone there? Please help me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Field_NPC_HelpCall_Female_3_Batk_B
string.body: The enemies are attacking! Is there anybody here?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Field_NPC_HelpCall_Shugo_3_Batk_B
string.body: Help me quickly! I'm about to get killed, nyerk!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Ab1_GChief_RageTA
string.body: Everyone gather around here! We'll protect you from the enemy swords!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Ab1_GChief_PMAttack
string.body: Enemy! Destroy them! I will give you strength! Go, and defeat the enemy!

string.name: STR_CHAT_ShugoSanta_AIPattern_1
string.body: I want to enjoy the festival, too, nyerk nyerk.

string.name: STR_CHAT_ShugoSanta_AIPattern_2
string.body: If it were not for the contract... akakak....

string.name: STR_CHAT_Rudolph_AIPattern_2
string.body: I haven't done anything wrong except that I was born with the red nose!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF3Lephar_TestResultFake_50_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: You are different from other Daevas!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF3Lephar_TestResultReal_50_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: I'll prove you that you are not perfect!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF3Lephar_TestResultReal_50_Ah_AIPattern_2
string.body: You fool Daeva are hastening your own death!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF3Lephar_TestResultReal_50_Ah_AIPattern_3
string.body: Just give up. You will be a dead meat anyway.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF3Lephar_TestResultReal_50_Ah_AIPattern_4
string.body: I am...a complete subject...how could I be ended by a Daeva?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF3Lephar_TestResultReal_50_Ah_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: I will beat into your head, incomplete Daeva.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_VampireQueenFake_50_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: Well met. I was looking for fresh blood!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_VampireQueenFake_50_Ah_AIPattern_2
string.body: You made me show my colours.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_VampireQueenFake_50_Ah_1_Katk2_b
string.body: Ah, I've missed this fresh blood for a long time.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_VampireQueenReal_50_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: You fool! You're just exciting me more!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_VampireQueenReal_50_Ah_AIPattern_2
string.body: Now, it's time for a feast of blood!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_VampireQueenReal_50_Ah_1_Batk_B
string.body: You made me like this. Be ready to pay dear!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_VampireQueenReal_50_Ah_2_Katk2_b
string.body: Bah, is this all you got?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_VampireQueenReal_50_Ah_1_Katk3_b
string.body: I've been waiting for a challenger like you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_VampireQueenReal_50_Ah_2_Katk3_b
string.body: I'll quench my thirst with your blood!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_Tesinon_50_Ah_2_Kcast2_b
string.body: How dare you come into a restricted area! You'll pay with your life!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_Tesinon_50_Ah_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: There is no way to run away!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_Tesinon_50_Ah_1_Katk5_b
string.body: I'll make you regret stepping in here!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_Tesinon_50_Ah_2_Katk5_b
string.body: You are as good as dead!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_SkeletonMageSum_50_An_AIPattern_1___t
string.body: [%target]! You dare to touch our Lord...!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF2A_NM_HolyServant_50_An_AIPattern_1
string.body: I have to check the el...elemental core generator...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_DeathKnight_50_Ah_1_Batk_b
string.body: Who dared to wake me up?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_DeathKnight_50_Ah_1_Kcast5_b
string.body: You are as good as dead!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_DeathKnight_50_Ah_1_Kcast10_b
string.body: You shall cost your life for your rudeness!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Princess_50_Ah_1_Kcast5_b
string.body: Are you trying to attack me?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Princess_50_Ah_2_Kcast5_b
string.body: As you hurt me, you will pay dear.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Princess_50_Ah_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: My charm will enslave you forever.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Princess_50_Ah_2_Kcast6_b
string.body: I'll make you a helpless idiot like Lannok.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Princess_50_Ah_2_Die_b
string.body: Ntuamu...I didn't know...revenge yourself in this way...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF2A_StatueTest_50_Ae_1_Batk_b
string.body: You should not have come here.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF2A_StatueTest_50_Ae_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: My sword is as sharp as it used to be.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF2A_StatueTest_50_Ae_1_Die_b
string.body: My cursed life seems to end here.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_GraveKnight_50_Ae_1_Batk_b
string.body: How dare you enter the castle of my seigneur without permission?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_GraveKnight_50_Ae_1_Kcast3_b
string.body: We knights will defend the castle!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_GraveKnight_50_Ae_1_Die_b
string.body: Will be loyal to the seigneur...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF2A_TesinonWatcher_50_Ae_1_Batk_b
string.body: You will be knocked down at a single blow!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF2A_TesinonWatcher_50_Ae_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: Not bad at all. Let's see how long you can stand.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_Banshee_50_Ae_1_Batk_b
string.body: This is not a place for commoners like you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_Banshee_50_Ae_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: I'll let you know what fear means.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_Banshee_50_Ae_1_Kcast3_b
string.body: You looked down on me, didn't you?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_Banshee_50_Ae_1_Die_b
string.body: I still...have many things to do...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_BansheeB_50_Ae_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: You'll shudder at my screaming, I promise.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_BansheeB_50_Ae_1_Kcast3_b
string.body: You won't walk out alive from this room!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_BansheeB_50_Ae_1_Die_b
string.body: Could I be born to a noble family in my next life...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_Succubus_50_Ae_1_Batk_b
string.body: A commoner infected with the epidemic!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_Succubus_50_Ae_1_Kcast3_b
string.body: If you fall asleep, I'll let you die without pain.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_Succubus_50_Ae_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: It's too late to run away!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_VampireNamed_50_Ae_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: How dare you! You know who I am!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_LichBlue_50_Ae_1_Die_b
string.body: What did you do to me...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_TestResultZombie_50_Ae_1_Die_b
string.body: I still have...much work to do...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_GraveKnight_50_Ae_1_Batk_b
string.body: Are you one of those who came for the treasure?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_GraveKnight_50_Ae_AIPattern_1
string.body: Excessive greed only costs your life!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_GraveKnight_50_Ae_AIPattern_2
string.body: Teach a lesson to that thief!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_DarkRangerBefore_50_Ae_1_Batk_b
string.body: How did you get here? This is not a place you belong to!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_DarkRanger_50_Ae_1_Batk_b
string.body: Red Laizes withered...the only thing left for Brusthonin is death!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BLDF2A_NM_DarkRanger_50_Ae_1_Die_b
string.body: Why I ended up...My lord Triniel...please...forgive, kwak...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Vampire_50_Ae_1_Kcast3_b
string.body: You should be my meal of day.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Vampire_50_Ae_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: Please don't move, or I cannot suck your blood.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Vampire_50_Ae_1_Kcast5_b
string.body: You should pay with your blood.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Succubus_50_Ae_AIPattern_1
string.body: Collect yourself! If you lower your guard, you will be eliminated in no time, huhu!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Succubus_50_Ae_1_Die_b
string.body: No! If I am gone, who will take care of...the princess...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_DeathKnight_50_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: Do you have any idea of what you did?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_DeathKnight_50_Ah_AIPattern_2
string.body: How dared you disturb the rest of the dead!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_DeathKnight_50_Ah_AIPattern_3
string.body: Okay, I'll lay you in the coffin too! Die!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Princess_50_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: Don't be rude, or I'll call my servants to take care of you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Princess_50_Ah_AIPattern_2
string.body: Let's see if you can be as haughty in front of my servants as you are now.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Princess_50_Ah_AIPattern_3
string.body: You lazy wretches! Can't you hear me calling you? Come out right now!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_PrincessSum_VampireMaid_50_An_1_Batk_b
string.body: Dear princess, your wish is my command.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_PrincessSum_VampireMaid_50_An_1_Kcast1_b
string.body: How dare you behave like that in my presence!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_PrincessSum_BansheeMaid_50_An_1_Batk_b
string.body: Dear princess, just count on us.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDDF2A_NM_Princess_50_Ah_1_Batk_b
string.body: How dare you enter here without permission! You don't belong here!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_MC_LizardPr_1_Batk_S
string.body: How dare you step in here!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_MC_Naga_AIPattern_1
string.body: I'll burn you to death in a second.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_MC_Naga_AIPattern_2
string.body: Only thing that awaits you is death.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_MC_Naga_AIPattern_5
string.body: How dare a greenhorn like you come here?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_MC_Naga_AIPattern_6
string.body: I will show you Nochsana's power!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Test_BionicArms_40_n_Batk_S
string.body: I'll throw you like a ball!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_ND2_WhHS_02
string.body: Transmit Command. Activate the defence system.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_ND2_WhHS_03
string.body: Transmit Command. Eliminate the interfering elements.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_ND2_WhHS_06
string.body: Command Complete. Convert to normal attack power.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_ND2_WhHS_07
string.body: Command Complete. Convert to normal defence shield.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_ND2_WhHS_08
string.body: Command Received. Initiating intruder extermination manoeuvres.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_FeB_50_An_1_Katk7_b
string.body: To feel how insignificant you are.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_FeG_50_An_1_Kcast7_b
string.body: Do you dare believe that you could defeat me?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_FeG_50_An_1_Katk7_b
string.body: You will learn what is the price you must pay for your foolishness.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_KeB_50_An_1_Kcast3_b
string.body: This moment will be the last chapter of your life!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_KeB_50_An_1_Kcast7_b
string.body: I shall take you to meet death face to face!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_KeB_50_An_1_Kcast8_b
string.body: Feel this, fool of a Daeva!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_KeB_50_An_1_Katk8_b
string.body: The terror that is the Anuhart Legion.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_KeG_50_An_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: Glory to His Greatness Lord Tiamat!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_KeG_50_An_1_Kcast7_b
string.body: Only thing that awaits you wretches is death!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_KeG_50_An_1_Kcast8_b
string.body: Feel it deep in your bones!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_KeG_50_An_1_Katk8_b
string.body: The gap between the mighty Balaur and wretched Daevas!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_KeS_50_An_1_Kcast5_b
string.body: Feel it deep in your bones!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_KeS_50_An_1_Katk5_b
string.body: The gap between the mighty Balaur and wretched Daevas!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_AeB_50_An_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: Remember it well should you leave here alive!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_AeB_50_An_1_Katk2_b
string.body: That you must always watch your back.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_AeB_50_An_1_Katk7_b
string.body: I order you to seep deep into the bones!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_AeG_50_An_1_Katk2_b
string.body: This is the end of the one who got careless!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_ReB_50_An_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: Beg for mercy from those weak Empyrean Lords of yours.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_ReB_50_An_1_Katk6_b
string.body: Death shall spread its wings over your body!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_ReB_50_An_1_Katk7_b
string.body: I shall give you pain excruciating enough to rupture all your veins!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_WeB_50_An_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: They will not touch even a scale of my body.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_WeB_50_An_1_Katk4_b
string.body: For the sleep that will take you to your death.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_WeB_50_An_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: Feel it deep in your bones!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_WeB_50_An_1_Katk6_b
string.body: The power of the mighty Balaur!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_WeS_50_An_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: I will grant you an opportunity to attack me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_WeS_50_An_1_Katk2_b
string.body: For I can withstand your puny attacks for a thousand years.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_WeS_50_An_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: May sleep descend on your shoulders!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_WeS_50_An_1_Katk4_b
string.body: Your slumber will go on forever, never to wake again!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_WeS_50_An_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: You will realise it even if you wish to deny it.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_WeS_50_An_1_Katk6_b
string.body: The gap between the mighty Balaur and wretched Daevas!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_EeB_F_50_An_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: O clumsy blessing of a weak Daeva.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_EeB_F_50_An_1_Katk5_b
string.body: Cast your shadow of destruction over Dark Poeta!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_EeB_F_50_An_1_Kcast7_b
string.body: I order you by the great power of Lord Tiamat!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_EeB_F_50_An_1_Katk7_b
string.body: Your blood shall turn to venom, and your bones shall grind to dust!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_PeB_50_An_1_Kcast3_b
string.body: I order you by the power of Lord Tiamat!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_PeB_50_An_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: I beseech you, O mighty Dragon Lord, please bless us with your protection!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BXDrakan_PeB_50_An_1_Katk7_b
string.body: Infuse vitality into the blood of my comrades!

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_89
string.body: I will deal with the most wicked one first.

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_92
string.body: I will deal with the easiest one first.

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_97
string.body: I better attack the most dim-witted one first.

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_101
string.body: You scoundrel! You dare attack my comrade!

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_102
string.body: Which one will be the easiest?

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_106
string.body: I'll get rid of the ugliest one first.

string.name: STR_CHAT_GhostElim1_50_Ah_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: Do not stand in my path!

string.name: STR_CHAT_GhostElim1_50_Ah_1_Katk11_b
string.body: Be gone, you enemy of nature!

string.name: STR_CHAT_GhostElim1_50_Ah_1_Katk10_b
string.body: It is becoming faint, my memories...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_MadBrownie_Male_50_Ae_Batk_s
string.body: Ko... Kobold will... Kill them all!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_MadBrownie_Male_50_Ae_Katk_s
string.body: Ko... Kobold will kill them! Kill... Them all!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_TmoliaDrakan_002_Batk_b
string.body: We must dispose of them all before the Brigade General arrives!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_TmoliaDrakan_003_Batk_b
string.body: Let no one come near the Room of Dimension!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_KabaraDrakan_001_Idle_b
string.body: I told you to keep a close eye on the spaller insects!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_KabaraDrakan_002_Idle_b
string.body: You are dead if a spaller insect hits another Drana lump again!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAB1_Dreadgion_Prisoner_001_Die_s
string.body: Am I to die here, at the hands of the enemy....

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAB1_Dreadgion_PrisonerRescue_002_s
string.body: Thank you so much. We will never forget your kindness.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAB1_Dreadgion_PrisonerRescue_003_s
string.body: I'm relieved that I am now able to report the result of my investigation.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanRAInspector_50_Ah_001_Idle_h
string.body: We must identify their infiltration route.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanRAInspector_50_Ah_002_Idle_h
string.body: Brigade General Baranath is waiting for our report.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanRAInspector_50_Ah_001_Batk_b
string.body: Art thou the wretches causing trouble here?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanFiSupply_50_Ae_001_Batk_b
string.body: Ye dare target the armoury! Pestilent oafs!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanFiSupply_50_Ae_001_Die_b
string.body: How... How could I be defeated by these wretches....

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDShip_ShulackAsHide_43_Ae_Batk_b
string.body: Do you still see just one of me?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G1_50_An_1_Kcast5_b
string.body: Shake with terror, minions of the Empyrean Lords.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G1_50_An_1_Katk5_b
string.body: I will show you the might of the Fire Dragon.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G1_50_An_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: Ye slaves of flame born from the heart of lava.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G1_50_An_1_Katk6_b
string.body: Cleave the earth, and rise up!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G1_50_An_1_Katk7_b
string.body: You shall turn into old bones buried in the ground!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G1_50_An_1_Katk8_b
string.body: Waves of destruction will overwhelm you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G2_50_An_1_Kcast4_b
string.body: Worship the power of the mighty Dragon Lord!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G2_50_An_1_Katk4_b
string.body: Sea of hellfire shall roll before you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G2_50_An_1_Kcast5_b
string.body: O descendants of fire, strong with the power of Drana.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G2_50_An_1_Katk5_b
string.body: Bestow the baptism of death on these wretched Daevas!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G2_50_An_1_Kcast6_b
string.body: O power of earth, flowing in the veins of Balaur!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G2_50_An_1_Katk6_b
string.body: Spring forth, as power of life!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G3_50_An_1_Kcast2_b
string.body: Ye with pitiful body that will one day return to ashes!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G3_50_An_1_Kcast8_b
string.body: Your soul shall be imprisoned in hell forever!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G3_50_An_1_Katk8_b
string.body: O death-bringing sleep, spread your broad wings!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G3_50_An_1_Kcast9_b
string.body: O power of earth, flowing in the veins of Balaur!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G3_50_An_1_Katk9_b
string.body: Spring forth, as power of life!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G3_50_An_1_Kcast10_b
string.body: O descendants of fire, strong with the power of Drana.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF1_Dragon_G3_50_An_1_Katk10_b
string.body: Bestow the baptism of death on these wretched Daevas!

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_112
string.body: I commend your effort of coming this far, and will play with you for a while. But, it will end if I don't judge you to be worthy.

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_113
string.body: Since you reached this far, I'll grant you the honour of facing me. But I will leave immediately if this honour is too much for you to bear.

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_114
string.body: You wretched Daeva! I shall punish you and send you to meet death face to face!

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_115
string.body: The only thing that awaits you wretches now is hell.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_CalydonAssassinre_43_Ae_1_kcast8_b
string.body: Huh, what is that? Sniff sniff.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_priest_43_Ae_1_kcast1_b
string.body: You can run, but you can't hide.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_priest_43_Ae_1_kcast8_b
string.body: This is not the time to sleep. Get up now!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_priest_43_Ae_1_kcast10_b
string.body: Steel Beard Pirates help each other!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_ranger_43_Ae_1_kcast1_b
string.body: Do not even think about moving!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_wizard_43_Ae_1_kcast5_b
string.body: Why don't you cry Kuu Kuu!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_Naga_001_Idle_b
string.body: How dare you come here, sheek!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_Boss_001_Idle_b
string.body: A wretched Daeva dared to come here?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_Boss_001_katk2_b
string.body: Ye shall know the greatness of the Drakan!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_Boss_001_die_b
string.body: The time of Balaur... is near...

string.name: STR_CHAT_CoDragon_AIPattern_116
string.body: How were you able to come all the way here with such meager strength? I do not find you worth my while any longer!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_ShulackScientist_50_Ae_001_Idle_b
string.body: You are trying to stop me? I can't forgive you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_ShulackScientist_50_Ae_002_Idle_b
string.body: The Drakan who locked me up, you Daevas trying to stop me.... I hate you all!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDLF1_ShulackScientist_50_Ae_001_Die_b
string.body: I still have many researches to do... It isn't fair!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_KingKongAhn_45_n_AIPattern_2
string.body: Don't go around eating whatever you see!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_KingKongAhn_45_n_AIPattern_3
string.body: Don't go around drinking whatever you see!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_KingKongAhn_45_n_AIPattern_4
string.body: Will you not listen to me! Don't eat them!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_KingKongAhn_45_n_AIPattern_5
string.body: Will you not listen to me! Don't drink them!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_KingKongAhn_45_n_AIPattern_7
string.body: Mantutu! Kill it and I will give you something delicious!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_KingKongAhn_45_n_AIPattern_8
string.body: Mantutu! Kill it and I will give you something refreshing!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_KingKongAhn_45_n_1_die_b
string.body: Who is going to look after Mantutu, when I'm... Gone...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Engineer_45_Ah_1_batk_b
string.body: You dared to enter the power chamber without my permission...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Engineer_45_Ah_1_die_b
string.body: No... Without me the ship will...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Engineer_45_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: I will show you the taste of Drana steam!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Engineer_45_Ah_1_kcast1_b
string.body: How impertinent! You dare mock me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Engineer_45_Ah_1_kcast3_b
string.body: Ugh, there is not enough Drana.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Engineer_45_Ah_AIPattern_2
string.body: Cough... Why don't we have a break before we continue with this fight.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Engineer_45_Ah_AIPattern_3
string.body: I will not go easy on you anymore!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Engineer_45_Ah_1_kcast5_b
string.body: I will manhandle you like a lump of Drana.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Engineer_45_Ah_1_kcast7_b
string.body: Come closer and you will be sorry!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Engineer_45_Ah_1_kcast8_b
string.body: Will you resist even after this?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_1_eatk_b
string.body: I can only laugh at your stupidity.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_1_die_b
string.body: Impossible... How could a greenhorn like you defeat me...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: You will not touch even a hair!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_3
string.body: Remove these annoying bugs from here!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_4
string.body: What are you lot not coming out?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_5
string.body: I will show you the skills of the Shulacks.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_6
string.body: Shulacks are more powerful than Daevas!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_7
string.body: Behold the might of the Steel Beard Pirates!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_8
string.body: I didn't think I'd have to resort to this! Brace yourself!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_9
string.body: Feel what it's like to be defeated by the power of Stigma!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_10
string.body: This is the power of your ancestors!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_11
string.body: How about this? Do you want to feel this too?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_12
string.body: Turn into a tree! I really love this skill!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_CaptainSum_1_die_b
string.body: Ugh... Captain... Please not the toilet cleaning...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_FirstMate_45_Ae_AIPattern_1
string.body: What have you done! You cruel bastards!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Madam_45_Ah_1_batk_b
string.body: Should have just gone home after a drink or two, tsk tsk.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Madam_45_Ah_1_kcast1_b
string.body: I have such a great figure!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Madam_45_Ah_1_kcast2_b
string.body: Must I beat you before you come to your senses.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Madam_45_Ah_1_kcast4_b
string.body: You will be enraptured by my beauty, too!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Madam_45_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: Mingming, come out and do what I'm feeding you for!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Gunner_45_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: You shan't get close to the cannon without my permission!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Gunner_45_Ah_AIPattern_2
string.body: You are mistaken if you think it's safe over there!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Gunner_45_Ah_AIPattern_3
string.body: No! You cannot go that way!

string.name: STR_CHAT_ShulackShip_ShugoRun_AIPattern_1
string.body: I am free at last, nyerk nyerk.

string.name: STR_CHAT_ShulackShip_ShugoRun_AIPattern_2
string.body: I can go home now, nyerk!

string.name: STR_CHAT_ShulackShip_ShugoRun_AIPattern_3
string.body: I better escape quickly, nyerk nyerk.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Gunner_45_Ah_1_batk_b
string.body: What the hell is this now?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Gunner_45_Ah_1_eatk_b
string.body: What pathetic Daevas. It's a wonder you managed to come this far.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Gunner_45_Ah_1_die_b
string.body: No... I must change the shell...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Gunner_45_Ah_1_kcast3_b
string.body: You let your guard down! I will attack first!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Gunner_45_Ah_1_kcast4_b
string.body: This will hurt quite a bit!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Gunner_45_Ah_2_kcast5_b
string.body: Feel the firepower of the Steel Rake Pirates!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Gunner_45_Ah_3_kcast5_b
string.body: Who knows? You may even be lucky enough to live!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF3CL_NM_LehparTestResult_45_Ah_AIPattern_1
string.body: This should be enough for these bugs.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF3CL_NM_LehparTestResult_45_Ah_AIPattern_2
string.body: Let's see if you can resist this too.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF3CL_NM_LehparTestResult_45_Ah_AIPattern_4
string.body: Only a complete man will live.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF3CL_NM_LehparWizard_45_Ah_1_eatk_b
string.body: This is no surprise. Evil is bound to fail.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF3CL_NM_LehparWizard_45_Ah_1_kcast1_b
string.body: Put your head down and repent!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF3CL_NM_LehparWizard_45_Ah_1_kcast4_b
string.body: Witness the power given to me by Lord Lephar!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDLF3CL_NM_LehparWizard_45_Ah_1_kcast6_b
string.body: Freeze to the top of your head!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanFi_50_Ae_kcast4_b
string.body: Bow to the great Dragon Lord!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanFi_50_Ae_kcast8_b
string.body: Glory to Lord Beritra! Death to wretched Daevas!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanSc_50_Ae_kcast2_b
string.body: Wings of death shall overshadow thee.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanSc_50_Ae_kcast5_b
string.body: I shall make thee realise the greatness of the Baranath Legion!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanMa_50_Ae_kcast3_b
string.body: You fools. There is nowhere to run!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanMa_50_Ae_kcast5_b
string.body: Thou shalt feel how lowly ye Daevas are compared to the Balaur.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanCl_50_Ae_kcast4_b
string.body: Hast thou realised that the only thing awaiting thee is thy doom?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDAb1_Dreadgion_DrakanCl_50_Ae_kcast8_b
string.body: I shall take thee to thy death.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Madam_45_Ah_2_kcast4_b
string.body: Oh my, I already have someone!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Madam_45_Ah_3_kcast4_b
string.body: Oh my, it's embarrassing when you look at me like that!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_13
string.body: You did try hard, but it's still not enough against me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_14
string.body: Right, it's time for you all to disappear!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_15
string.body: Anyway, where the hell are these guys when the Captain is in trouble!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_16
string.body: Why can't I have even a glimpse of them?! I'm going to discipline them till their beard falls out!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_AIPattern_17
string.body: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, and a Stigma for a Stigma!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_1_kcast2_b
string.body: Now that all my men are here, let's get serious with this fight!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDShulack_Captain_45_Ah_2_kcast2_b
string.body: Hmph hmph, I feel exhausted from all the shouting. Anyway, here we begin!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDShip_FShulackWiBreeder_42_Ae_AIPattern_1
string.body: Intruders! Quickly hide the key box!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_FANATIC_KeC_start
string.body: Death to anyone who gets in my way!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_FANATIC_BossEL_summon
string.body: Foolish children! You will learn fear.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_FANATIC_Gossip_01
string.body: You really think you can take me on?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_FANATIC_Gossip_02
string.body: You'll drown in blood. Do you hear me? In blood!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_GateKeeper_Satk_01
string.body: My Flaying Curse will tear apart your soul!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimBoss_Batk_01
string.body: Who dares seek out the Petralith?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimBoss_Satk_01
string.body: You're stronger than I thought, but not strong enough.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimBoss_Satk_02
string.body: Hah! Your puny arms will be your undoing.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimBoss_Satk_03
string.body: This rock shall be your grave.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimBoss_Satk_06
string.body: I'll bury you under the ground you walk on.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimBoss_Satk_07
string.body: Now you've done it. No mercy!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimBoss_Die_01
string.body: Great Aion! Please forgive your poor servant...who has failed to fulfil his duties...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimExpert_Batk_01
string.body: I'll kill anyone who disturbs my work!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimExpert_Satk_01
string.body: You, weaver. Get over here and help me.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimExpert_Satk_02
string.body: May the undying flame burn you to ashes!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_NepilimExpert_Satk_03
string.body: I'll beat you to a paste!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_FANATIC_Idle_Gossip_03
string.body: I think this is a sign of Daevas...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_FANATIC_Idle_Gossip_05
string.body: I've got a bad feeling about this.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_FANATIC_Idle_Gossip_08
string.body: It's been a long time since I went out...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDTP_FANATIC_Idle_Gossip_10
string.body: Did you catch what Lord Malika said a second ago?

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_Shulack_Knight_Gossip_01
string.body: I can forgive Krall mocking, but...

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_Shulack_Knight_Gossip_02
string.body: I can't forgive those who mock Krall!

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_Shulack_Gossip_01
string.body: You'll never get back home alive!

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_ArchPriest2_Gossip_01
string.body: You pitiful worms! Kneel before your betters.

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_ArchPriest2_Gossip_02
string.body: Do you think the Seal of Tiamat is nothing?

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_ArchPriest2_Gossip_03
string.body: This is the end. Your end.

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_DeathKnight_Gossip_04
string.body: You thought I'd make an easy target?

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_Shulack_Rufukin
string.body: You saved my life. Thank you very much!

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_DeathKnight_Taros
string.body: Finally! I'm free of the curse! I'll never forget your kindness.

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_Spectre_Ahbahna
string.body: I curse you all. From the depths of the Abyss, a curse upon all who disturb the graves!

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_Taros_EnterAttackState
string.body: Tiamat's servants, rejoice! I've come for you.

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_Archpriest_Gossip_02
string.body: You'll always be a slave, Taros!

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_Archpriest_DeadlyAttack
string.body: By the glory of the Great Dragon Lord, the wing of death shall spread across the world!

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_Archpriest_Gossip_03
string.body: Do you have any idea what a mistake you've made?

string.name: STR_IDCatacombs_Boss_Archpriest_LeaveAttackState
string.body: Fools! Now do you understand the might of the Balaur?

string.name: STR_LF4_Gateway_Li_Guard_Boss_AL_Gossip_02
string.body: Focus! The enemy will fall before us!

string.name: STR_DF4_Gateway_Da_Guard_Boss_AL_Gossip_03
string.body: Do you really think I'll give up?

string.name: STR_DF4_Owllaunamed_Ah_Gossip_01
string.body: You managed to get this far?

string.name: STR_DF4_OwllauPriest_Ae_Gossip_01
string.body: It is too late for regrets!

string.name: STR_IDCT_Boss_StatueDrakan_system_01
string.body: Virhana's Curse activates once the Indomitable Armour disappears.

string.name: STR_IDCT_Boss_StatueDrakan_01
string.body: Who dares despoil this holy place?

string.name: STR_IDCT_Boss_StatueDrakan_02
string.body: My curse shall be upon you!

string.name: STR_IDCT_TiamatDrakan_01_Batk_b
string.body: Bow to Lord Tiamat's will, or face the consequences.

string.name: STR_IDCT_Boss_LichKing_03
string.body: That'll make a meal for Master Macunbello!

string.name: STR_IDCT_Boss_Rudra_01
string.body: Freedom! And what luck that you're the first thing I've seen, Daeva.

string.name: STR_IDCT_Boss_Rudra_03
string.body: Come, thunder. Come, lightning. Wreak your havoc!

string.name: STR_IDCT_Boss_Rudra_05
string.body: I can feel it. My powers are coming back!

string.name: STR_IDCT_Boss_Rudra_06
string.body: Even sealed, you worthless bugs are no match for me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Q20023_FanaticWiQ_52_An_001_Batk_S
string.body: Hello, airon. Come for the slaughter?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Q20023_FanaticWiQ_52_An_002_atk_S
string.body: I won't hurt you too much.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Q20023_FanaticWiQ_53_An_001_Batk_S
string.body: You'll beg to serve Lord Beritra!

string.name: STR_LF4_Raidnew_Gossip_01
string.body: The intruders shall be judged! -before Showtime (Temporary)

string.name: STR_LF4_RaidnewsumA_Gossip_02
string.body: I will self-destruct before you take me! (Temporary)

string.name: STR_LF4_RaidnewsumB_Gossip_01
string.body: Nothing but pain for the intruders! (Temporary)

string.name: STR_LF4_RaidnewsumE_Gossip_02
string.body: Don't miss your chance to die! (Temporary)

string.name: STR_DF4_Raidnew_Gossip_04
string.body: It's too late for regrets!-before Showtime (Temporary)

string.name: STR_Dread02_Drakan_Boss_01
string.body: Thou shalt all return to the Aether's flow!

string.name: STR_Dread02_Drakan_Boss_02
string.body: Kneel before the might of the earth!

string.name: STR_Dread02_Drakan_Boss_04
string.body: I will not be undone by some lowly Daevas!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDNovice_02_DBrownieWWa_named_18_an_1_Die_S
string.body: Where am I? Why is Kobold here...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDNovice_05_RatmanMWa_named_19_an_1_Die_S
string.body: Odella to Master Hamerun... Hamerun? Who is Hamerun, MuMu...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanAs_55_Ae_kcsat4_b
string.body: Thou shalt regret sullying this place!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanAsNoble_55_Ae_kcast4_b
string.body: Canst thee not see the wings of death hovering over thee?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanAsNoble_55_Ae_kcast8_b
string.body: Kneel before the power of Lord Tiamat!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanFiNoble_55_Ae_kcast4_b
string.body: I'll show thee the true power of the Chantra Legion!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanFiNoble_55_Ae_kcast8_b
string.body: How dost it feel to come face to face with thy own Vanishment?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanScNoble_55_Ae_kcast2_b
string.body: This arrow will be the messenger of death!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanScNoble_55_Ae_kcast3_b
string.body: How dare ye set foot in here! Pay for thy insolence with Vanishment!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanWiNoble_55_Ae_kcast3_b
string.body: I will show thee the epic darkness of Vanishment!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanWiNoble_55_Ae_kcast5_b
string.body: Thou shalt come to learn the greatness of Lord Tiamat!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanClNoble_55_Ae_kcast8_b
string.body: For the glory of the Chantra Legion!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanWiBonus_55_Ae_001_Batk_b
string.body: How could they let these ignorant Daevas come this far?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanWiBonus_55_Ae_kcast4_b
string.body: Behold the incredible might of Kamanya!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_02_DrakanAsWait_55_Ae_kcast4_b
string.body: You won't get to lay a finger on these supplies!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDNovice_02_DBrownieWWo_18_an_1_Idle_S
string.body: I won't lose the Odium! It will go to the Haramel Tower!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDNovice_05_RatmanGathererMWa_19_an_1_Idle_S
string.body: I haven't dug the Odella to send to the tower... You are interrupting me, MuMu!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDNovice_07_DBrownieWWa_keeper_20_an_1_Idle_S
string.body: We will need another iron cage!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDNovice_04_RatmanMWa_Key_18_an_1_Idle_S
string.body: I won't give the key to you, MuMu.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Underpass_NepilimNamed_55_Al_001_idle_S
string.body: Aaaargh, I will not forgive you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Underpass_NepilimNamed_55_Al_002_idle_S
string.body: I can't bear this any longer!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2low_PrisonerWoman3_38_An_001_Idle_S
string.body: Hehehe, I'm going to kill you all.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2low_PrisonerMan4_38_An_001_Idle_S
string.body: Think you can get out of here alive...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2low_Rguard2_38_An_001_Idle_S
string.body: Ahhh, how refreshing! This is why I do this work.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2low_Rguard2_38_An_002_Idle_S
string.body: Hey! Give us something to eat here.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2low_PrisonGuards_38_An_1_Batk_S
string.body: How convenient, you spare me the trouble of looking for you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2low_Trigger_Torture_38_An_001_Idle_S
string.body: Heh heh.... You won't be able to resist for much longer.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Mguard5_38_An_001_Idle_S
string.body: I wonder when I can see his Honour, the judge...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Mguard5_38_An_002_Idle_S
string.body: It's getting harder and harder to make a living.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Rguard5_38_An_001_Idle_S
string.body: I don't know if she will like it or not.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Rguard5_38_An_002_Idle_S
string.body: I couldn't tell you the last time I saw some Kinah...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Chef2_38_An_001_Idle_S
string.body: I prepared a special dish today, so everyone please try it.

string.name: STR_IDCromede_1low_Hierarch
string.body: I will send you away painlessly!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4_DrakanEvent_01
string.body: I will kill you all, you pathetic Elyos!

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdA_EnterAttackState
string.body: Curses to those who disturb the Current of Life.

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdA_UseSkill
string.body: O Breath of Life, return to the embrace of Pazuzu!

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdA_OnDie_01
string.body: Finally... I can return to him...

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdA_OnDie_02
string.body: Pazuzu has finally... found a way to return...

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdD_EnterAttackState_02
string.body: Your pathetic power won't get you to the artefact.

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdD_UseSkill_01
string.body: You dare threaten me with attacks such as that!

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdD_UseSkill_02
string.body: Creatures of Aether, come forth and aid me!

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdD_UseSkill_03
string.body: Return to the flow of Aether, Daevas!

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdD_UseSkill_04
string.body: Only death awaits those who intrude.

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdD_OnDie
string.body: Ah... I must protect... the... Tower...

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdDH_EnterAttackState_01
string.body: You won't touch the artefact, no matter what happens!

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdDH_EnterAttackState_02
string.body: Those who threaten the artefact shall be returned to the flow of Aether!

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdDH_UseSkill_01
string.body: Face the wrath of the protector!

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdDH_UseSkill_02
string.body: Only death awaits those who intrude.

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdDH_OnDie_01
string.body: I will curse you until the end...

string.name: STR_IDAbRe_Core_NmdDH_OnDie_02
string.body: Ah... The power, the power of... Aion is...

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDNovice_BrownieWa_NM_20_An_1_kcast1_b
string.body: Save me! Save me! Save me! Waaah!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4Raid_02
string.body: Omega summons a creature. Rise from your slumber, my golem!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4Raid_03
string.body: Omega and his summoned creature use a condition changing skill on the player. Power of the ancient dragon!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4Raid_04
string.body: Omega and his summoned creature begin their attack. Go, my faithful golem!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF4Raid_05
string.body: Omega summons a creature that gives him great strength. Rise from your slumber, my brother!

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF4Raid_01
string.body: Ha ha ha, I will destroy everything! (Balaurean)

string.name: STR_CHAT_DF4Raid_05
string.body: I curse this world that created me! (Strong Balaurean)

string.name: STR_CHAT_Hierarch_01
string.body: Time to show you my hidden powers!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Hierarch_02
string.body: Turn back now and I might forgive you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Hierarch_03
string.body: I can't let the seal be broken like this....

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDCromede_2low_Key_GuardBoss_38_An_1_Batk_S
string.body: You have some guts coming out of there!

string.name: STR_CHAT_BGuardBoss_02
string.body: Damn it, master Kaliga has raised a Karnif pup.

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDCromede_2low_Key_GuardBoss_38_An_1_Die_S
string.body: Nevertheless, you won't be able to leave here alive!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Torture_01
string.body: Kukuku, what do we have here...a new toy?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Torture_02
string.body: What do you think of this pain?

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDCromede_2up_Key_Butler_38_An_1_Die_S
string.body: I must inform my master that a guest has arrived....

string.name: STR_CHAT_Wife_01
string.body: Oh my! Who are you, and how dare you stroll into my bedroom just like that?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Wife_02
string.body: Why don't you try playing with my kids?

string.name: STR_CHAT_Wife_03
string.body: Just wait. Once I let my husband know, you will be finished.

string.name: STR_CHAT_AssiJudge_01
string.body: My skills are superior to yours!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Trigger_Wound_Wife_38_An_1_Batk_S
string.body: My husband is angry now! You are finished!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Trigger_Wound_AssiJudge_38_An_1_Batk_S
string.body: It's time for payback...you better be prepared!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Trigger_Wound_Torture_38_An_1_Batk_S
string.body: I will let you feel my fury once more.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Judge_01
string.body: What...what are you all doing? Attack! Attack!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Judge_03
string.body: Still, you shouldn't look down on me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Judge_04
string.body: I seem to have raised a...Karnif pup!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AngryJudge_01
string.body: You dare challenge me? How exciting!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AngryJudge_03
string.body: Beg for my forgiveness, before it's too late!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AngryJudge_04
string.body: You really...fan the flame of my anger.

string.name: STR_CHAT_AngryJudge_05
string.body: To think that I'd ever be forced onto my knees....

string.name: STR_CHAT_BIDNovice_RatmanWa_NM_20_An_1_katk2_b
string.body: MuMu Ham is dead! Ugh! Stop hitting me! MuMu!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Hierarch_04
string.body: Shhh. First give a prayer to Empyrean Lady Siel.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Hierarch_05
string.body: I see that mere words aren't going to be enough.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Hierarch_06
string.body: Lady Siel, please save the one who has been a fool.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Hierarch_07
string.body: I shall easily send you away!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Hierarch_08
string.body: I guess I have no choice but to resort to this.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Hierarch_11
string.body: And give enlightenment to the foolish one!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Judge_05
string.body: No dinner for those who have been lazy!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Judge_06
string.body: This is precisely what those who seek to better themselves need!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Judge_07
string.body: You have become powerful, Kromede. But still not enough to contend with me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Judge_08
string.body: I feel tired and need some rest.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Judge_10
string.body: You still have a long way to go. I will summon an opponent who will suit you perfectly.

string.name: STR_CHAT_AngryJudge_09
string.body: Beg for forgiveness before it's too late!

string.name: STR_CHAT_AngryJudge_10
string.body: You fool, it's too late for regrets!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2low_ServantMan_38_An_1_Batk_S
string.body: I shall beat some sense into you with my broom.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2low_ServantWoman_38_An_1_Batk_S
string.body: And I just finished cleaning, too. I can't forgive you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Mguard2_38_An_2_Batk_S
string.body: You traitor! How dare you show up here like this!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Mguard4_38_An_2_Batk_S
string.body: This is no place for you to be, Kromede!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Rguard2_38_An_1_Batk_S
string.body: We have intruders inside the manor!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Rguard2_38_An_2_Batk_S
string.body: How did you manage to make it this far?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2up_Rguard4_38_An_2_Batk_S
string.body: Intruders! Check for any weak points in the security!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_Chef_Event_03
string.body: Will you be able to cook up anything decent that way?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_Chef_Event_04
string.body: I will do my best, head chef!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDCromede_2low_PrisonerWoman3_38_An_002_Idle_S
string.body: It is so damn tiring being surrounded by so many ugly beings!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Maravata01
string.body: Problematic elements identified. Initiating elimination procedures.

string.name: STR_CHAT_ShulackNM_07
string.body: Eliminating all life forms within range.

string.name: STR_CHAT_Branch_Event_Shulackwizard_99_n_1_Batk_S
string.body: Actually I'm a salt thief!! Puhaha!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Branch_Event_XmasEvent_Rudolph_99_n_1_Batk_S
string.body: Hey, I was just taking a break, nyerk!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Branch_Event_XmasEvent_Rudolph_99_n_2_Batk_S
string.body: This will not get you any presents, naughty Daeva!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Branch_Event_XmasEvent_ShugoSantaD_99_n_1_Batk_S
string.body: Stop it! My union will hear about this, nyerk!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Branch_Event_XmasEvent_ShugoSantaD_99_n_2_Batk_S
string.body: Fine, fine, I am going! Just leave me alone!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Drana_Shulack_01
string.body: You saved my life. Thank you very much!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Drana_Shulack_02
string.body: Go to Inokin! He will repay you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Drana_Named_B_02
string.body: I will send the cursed ones to the flow of Aether!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Drana_Named_B_03
string.body: Ugh, Warden Surama, I've failed you...

string.name: STR_CHAT_Drana_Named_E_02
string.body: You dare to ruin my experiment?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Drana_Named_E_03
string.body: Flap your wings, little Daeva, but you'll never escape!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Drana_Named_E_05
string.body: How could my plans... be ruined like this...?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuFIKN_01
string.body: We won't let Daevas steal our technology!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuWIPR_01
string.body: This Balaur technology is ours! Bought and paid for!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuRAAS_01
string.body: We won't let you escape with our secrets!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuFIKN_02
string.body: No Daevas will get away with our technology!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuWIPR_02
string.body: We'll destroy the power generator before we let Daevas get their hands on it!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuRAAS_02
string.body: No! We worked so hard to get that technology!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuGuardian_01
string.body: We have intruders! Alert the elder!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuGuardian_02
string.body: Don't you dare touch the power generator!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuGuardian_03
string.body: Only Engineering League members past this point.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuGuardian_04
string.body: No Daevas in here, I'm warning you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_ShuGuardian_05
string.body: Now that you've come inside, you won't get out unscathed!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_DrakanGuardian_01
string.body: What were the Watchers thinking to allow Daevas to get this far?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_DrakanWiNoble_01
string.body: Destroy them! Don't let them disturb Nastika!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDStation_Zone3Boss_01
string.body: Impressive. But this is as far as you go!

string.name: STR_CHAT_S2_Saam1_02
string.body: Tsk, so you know what's good for your health, eh!

string.name: STR_CHAT_S3_Elemeltal_Water_55_Ah
string.body: My tides will make you dance!

string.name: STR_CHAT_S3_Elemeltal_Fire_55_Ah_01
string.body: Ah, a sacrifice for my flames!

string.name: STR_CHAT_S3_Elemeltal_Air_55_Ah_01
string.body: I am the terror that blows in from afar!

string.name: STR_CHAT_Gateboss_Patterns_01
string.body: Hah! Run, then! I will not waste my time in the chase.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElemental2_Prisoner_Gossip_01
string.body: Please check what element these bars belong to! You need to transform into a Spirit of the opposite element to break the bars!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElemental2_Prisoner_Gossip_02
string.body: Bonfire, Bucket, Soil Mound and Pinwheel each have magical power needed to transform into a Spirit with a specific element. Use those items!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDElemental2_Prisoner_Gossip_03
string.body: That damned Cadella locked us in this prison. Please transform into a Spirit and break these bars!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S6_VanqJr_55_An
string.body: You sealed me! I've killed Daevas before, youngling, and I'll kill them again. Starting with you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_B1_Arminos1s
string.body: Maybe you'll relieve this perpetual boredom...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_B1_Arminos2s1
string.body: Oh my word... You redefine the meaning of "tough love"! Poor pet...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_B1_Arminos2s2
string.body: There are still chests left. I shall try once more!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_B1_Arminos3s2
string.body: Think you'll survive, hmm? Think you'll win?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_B1_ArminosFs1
string.body: I trained that one myself.... I'm impressed, [%username].

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_B1_ArminosFs2
string.body: Fine. Take the present! But things come around, [%username]. Things won't always be so... Rosy!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S4_System3
string.body: No! I will rip you apart!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S4_Komu3
string.body: My mane is something else, huh?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S1_Agrint
string.body: So it's you.... Yes, I will face you....

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S4B_Bbobi
string.body: Wuaah! Help Poppy! Kobolds trying to eat Poppy!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Hameroon_Die
string.body: Beaten again... But this still isn't over....

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Kaliga
string.body: I will destroy anyone who stands in my way!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Fi_L
string.body: Relax... This will be over soon....

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Ma_L
string.body: I'll go easy on you. There's no sport in obliteration.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Pr_L_Die
string.body: Next time... I won't go so easy!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Kaliga_Orb
string.body: Time to use the Crystal Ball.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Fi_Change
string.body: See how you do against Templar skills...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S4_Wir_01
string.body: Know your place, cur! Your skills are inadequate!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S4_Anger_01
string.body: Where are the guards! Who are you?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S4_Anger_02
string.body: My beautiful Bloodwings will see to you!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S4_Hammam_01
string.body: Your body can only take so many blows, pup.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S4_Hammam_02
string.body: Haha! Maybe I should try some of my torture methods...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S4_Hammam_03
string.body: Ugh. How could I be worse... Than you?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Enchant_02
string.body: At least the godstone won't go to waste with you.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Trade_01
string.body: I brought my favourite weapon. Let's fight! Nyerk nyerk!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Trade_02
string.body: Strong Daeva! Knew it! Saw it in your eyes! Yes yes!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_As_D
string.body: My weapon's broken and rotting. You shouldn't be afraid to fight!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_As_D_Die
string.body: Yes, yes. You should be able to do this much, at least.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Ma_D
string.body: Don't just stand there - attack me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Pr_D_Die
string.body: May the Empyrean Lords... Watch over you...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Pr_Change_D
string.body: Grant this Cleric power, Lord Marchutan!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Enchant_01_D
string.body: Have you socketed a godstone yet?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Enchant_02_D
string.body: Yes! The godstone will not be wasted in your hands.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Trade_01_D
string.body: You don't underestimate a trade broker!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_S5_Ware_01_D
string.body: I'm as good a fighter as I am a warehouse manager! Fight me!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_H1_DrakanAs_noble_01
string.body: Pesky wretches! I shall destroy you all!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_H1_DrakanAs_noble_02
string.body: Ugh... Your Temple is finished - Lord Tiamat now knows of it...

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDArena_Solo_H1_Temple_01
string.body: How did the Balaur get this far?!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_DrakanFighter_Ae_Enter_Attack
string.body: Daevas? Thou art fools to come here!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_DrakanKnight_Ae_Enter_Attack
string.body: I'll make a wandering Raksang ghost!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_DrakanKnight_Ae_Attack_HitPoint
string.body: Come. I'll show you true horror!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_DrakanScout_Ae_Attack_HitPoint
string.body: It will be too late when you start bleeding!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_DrakanCFighter_Ae_Enter_Attack
string.body: It's too late to run away!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_DrakanCHealer_Ae_Attack_HitPoint
string.body: I'm not just going to die like this!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_NagaBoneMage_Ae_Enter_Attack
string.body: You came into your tomb, sheek.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_DrakanBoneKnight_Ae_Attack_HitPoint
string.body: You will see the Flames of Hell.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_DrakanBoneAssassin_Ae_Attack_HitPoint
string.body: I will dispatch of you painlessly.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_DrakanGhostFighter_Ae_Enter_Attack
string.body: No one has invaded here for several million years.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_NagaGhostMage_Ae_Enter_Attack
string.body: Do you want to be a ghost? Sheek.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDRaksha_NagaGhostMage_Ae_Attack_HitPoint
string.body: You have little power, but I want it. Sheek.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDShulackShip_Rose_Die_AllClass3
string.body: I don't want to die before I've seen the queen, yo-ho!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_DrakanBroad
string.body: Thy presence is unwelcome, filthy Daeva!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_DrakanVil_02
string.body: The Terath Legion is no common foe!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_DrakanNoble_01
string.body: Die for the honour of Lord Tiamat!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_DrakanNoble_02
string.body: Embrace the futility of thy cause!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_DrakanF_01
string.body: This Dredgion shall deliver thee to thy doom!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Named_Hack_01
string.body: Defend the Surkana at all costs!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Named_Hack_02
string.body: Thou shalt not touch this Surkana!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Named_Control
string.body: Thou shalt regret stepping into my domain!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Named_Supply_01
string.body: Mayhap thy flesh shalt make fine rations!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Named_Supply_02
string.body: This is no place for the likes of thee!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Named_Wait_01
string.body: Thy impudence shall be rewarded with death!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Named_Wait_02
string.body: The Drakan rule over you filth!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Named_Giant_01
string.body: Ah, finally, a balm to this dull duty!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Named_Giant_02
string.body: Thy weakness is evident to all with eyes.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_SemiBoss
string.body: Didst thou actually think the Captain would be undefended?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Boss
string.body: Thou hast caused much grief on my ship. Now it is time to pay!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_03_Gravity
string.body: This room shall be thy grave!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_DrakanBroad
string.body: You're going to regret that you ever set your dirty feet down in this place!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_DrakanVil_02
string.body: I am going to show this[f:"this"] insignificant Daeva the true power of the Terath Legion!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_DrakanNoble_01
string.body: Show deference to the power of Tiamat!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_DrakanNoble_02
string.body: For the honour of the Terath Legion!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_DrakanF_01
string.body: Foolish Daevas! You will all die!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_Named_Hack_01
string.body: Protect the Surkana at any cost!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_Named_Hack_02
string.body: You're not going to lay your fingers on this Surkana!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_Named_Control
string.body: You wretched Daeva, I'm going to tear you to pieces!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_Named_Supply_02
string.body: Don't even think about touching these supplies!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_Named_Wait_02
string.body: Despicable Daevas! I'll show you just how weak you are!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_Named_Giant_01
string.body: Hahaha! What a nice diversion! I was very bored anyway.

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_Named_Giant_02
string.body: I'm being challenged by a little twerp?

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_SemiBoss
string.body: Now I'm going to show you the meaning of true fear!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_Boss
string.body: So there you are! You've caused us a lot of grief. Now it's time for you to pay!

string.name: STR_CHAT_IDDreadgion_04_Gravity
string.body: This room will be your grave!

string.name: STR_TEST_MONSTER_JSJ_01
string.body: You are too slow. Start over.

string.name: STR_Test_Monster_SSH_ATTACK
string.body: You are too slow. Let's start again from the beginning.

string.name: STR_CHAT_F5_GuardianBoss_01
string.body: Where do you want to go?

string.name: STR_CHAT_F5_GuardianBoss_04
string.body: I can't tolerate this any longer!

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF5_Quest_Nmd_Fi_HpDrain_01
string.body: Is that supposed to impress me?

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF5_Quest_Nmd_Fi_HpDrain_02
string.body: Nothing could destroy my loyalty to him.

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF5_Quest_Nmd_Fi_HpDrain_04
string.body: I don't know what that is, either... I just know that Tiamat submerged the continent and sealed the new continent away in order to hide it...

string.name: STR_CHAT_LF5_Quest_Nmd_Fi_HpDrain_05
string.body: That is... a creature that will burn in Hell forever... even Tiamat fears this ancient being...
